stem: Factor VIII can be made as a recombinant human protein.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Name the disease that is treated using recombinant human factor VIII.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
Before recombinant human factor VIII was available, this disease was treated with factor VIII from donated blood.

Give **two** advantages of using recombinant human factor VIII, instead of factor VIII from donated blood, to treat this disease.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: The gene that codes for human factor VIII can be synthesised from messenger RNA purified from human liver cells.
parts.text: Name the enzyme that uses messenger RNA as a template to produce complementary DNA.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Outline **two** sources, other than messenger RNA, from which genes can be obtained for genetic engineering.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The gene that codes for human factor VIII can be transferred into mammalian cells in tissue culture.

Explain why a promoter also needs to be transferred into the mammalian cells so that human factor VIII can be synthesised.
